description.value: Walmart Supercentre is a large-format retail store in Kelowna offering a full grocery department alongside electronics, clothing, furniture, and baby goods under one roof. As one of the largest grocery destinations in the area, it is a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists needing food staples, packaged goods, or basic household supplies. The store operates under the Walmart Canada banner as store 3042.
